title: Calamari
description: Squids drop calamari! Fully integrated into vanilla gameplay, with fishing, loot, villager trades and more.
body:
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9c5a383ba44632e62eaa4f00b2c202e4eb1e9884.png) ## 🦑 What a catch! Squids have always been a familiar sight drifting through Minecraft's oceans. This mod gives them a little more to offer: squids and glow squids now drop Calamari! Cook it over a campfire, sell it to the village fisherman, share it with your cat, or feed it to a dolphin to be led to buried treasure.

Item Hunger Saturation
Calamari (raw) 2 0.8
Cooked Calamari 5 6.0


## 🎣 Where to find it - Squid and glow squid drop 1–2 raw calamari. - Occasionally pulled up while fishing. - Dropped by guardians and elder guardians, and now and then by dolphins. - Found in village fisher chests and buried treasure, and turns up in trial chamber rewards. - A cat may leave some as a morning gift; a Hero of the Village fisherman may gift some too.

![Calamari](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/z0rgiRT8/images/01f461230348f070f46070c6fabbc323ed692ae0.png)

## 🧩 How it fits in - Cats and ocelots take calamari as food. - Wolves eat it raw or cooked. - Give it to a dolphin and they lead you to treasure! - Fisherman villagers buy raw calamari and sell the cooked version. - Tagged as seafood (`c:foods`, `c:foods/raw_fish`, `c:foods/cooked_fish`, `c:foods/seafood`) to ensure compatibility with other mods.

## ⚙️ Configuration There's a few configuration options available.
Option Default Effect
Calamari in generated loot On Adds calamari to chests, fishing, and mob drops.
Villager trades On The fisherman's calamari trades.
